lines: I should get back to tracing roads on fresh <pulse>parchment</pulse>.
Best I mark that next road before the shape slips my mind.
A few landmarks still need notes while I remember them clearly.
The map on my table is waiting for a steadier hand than mine was this morning.
I promised a captain I would check a border before the week is out.
Back to plotting paths and keeping the records clear.
I need to redraw the creek line before the next trader follows the wrong bend.
Somewhere out there is a trail I have not named yet.
I will return to <pulse>ink</pulse>, compass, and patience now.
<pulse>Back</pulse> to it before night makes every path look the same.
